title: INDIRECT coerces numbers/logicals in ref_text to text (#REF!), treats omitted a1 as TRUE vs written-omitted/blank a1 as FALSE, and lifts over arrays
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527.20088, INDIRECT(ref_text, [a1]) coerces ref_text to text (so numbers and logicals like INDIRECT(123) or INDIRECT(TRUE) become "123"/"TRUE" and return #REF!), defaults a1 to TRUE when omitted from the call while treating a written-but-omitted or blank a1 as FALSE (R1C1), rejects digit strings like "1" in a1 with #VALUE!, lifts over array ref_text arguments (e.g. SUMPRODUCT(SUBTOTAL(9,INDIRECT({"Data!E1:E2";"Data!A1:A2"})))), and returns #REF! for invalid names or closed workbooks. All 3,644 full-bank INDIRECT rows match.
basis: Measured in DnaCalc jnt_lookup rows 75-77, dcb1l_language rows 117-119, and prefix_metadata row 26 (Excel 16.0.20527.20088); 3,644/3,644 full-bank rows match.
